objectives: This course is designed to develop students‘ skills in writing and textual analysis.
content: "In this course you will have weekly readings, mainly your writing, put on the board and analyzed as building toward a course theme.
grading_policy: "A midterm paper and a final, paper that is, not a finale, not a grand exit, nothing is ever final except catastrophe, plus weekly writing."
